theorem QOU.Mathlib.threeRow_vanishing_of_pinning {R : Type u_1} [AddCommMonoid R] [PartialOrder R] [CovariantClass R R (fun (x1 x2 : R) => x1 + x2) fun (x1 x2 : R) => x1 ≤ x2] (y : (n : ℕ) → { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n } → R) (hnn : ∀ (n : ℕ) (l : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n + 1 }), 0 ≤ y (n + 1) l) (hdom : ∀ (n : ℕ) (m : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n }) (l : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n + 1 }), (∃ (c : ℕ × ℕ) (hc : IsCornerCell (↑l) c), eraseCorner (↑l) c hc = ↑m) → y (n + 1) l ≤ y n m) (m₀ : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = 3 }) (hm₀ : 3 ≤ (↑m₀).colLen 0) (hpin : y 3 m₀ = 0) (k : ℕ) (l : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = 3 + k }) :
3 ≤ (↑l).colLen 0 → y (3 + k) l = 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.threeRow_vanishing_all_levels {R : Type u_1} [AddCommMonoid R] [PartialOrder R] [CovariantClass R R (fun (x1 x2 : R) => x1 + x2) fun (x1 x2 : R) => x1 ≤ x2] (y : (n : ℕ) → { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n } → R) (hnn : ∀ (n : ℕ) (l : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n + 1 }), 0 ≤ y (n + 1) l) (hdom : ∀ (n : ℕ) (m : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n }) (l : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n + 1 }), (∃ (c : ℕ × ℕ) (hc : IsCornerCell (↑l) c), eraseCorner (↑l) c hc = ↑m) → y (n + 1) l ≤ y n m) (base : ∀ (m : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = 3 }), 3 ≤ (↑m).colLen 0 → y 3 m = 0) (k : ℕ) (l : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = 3 + k }) :
3 ≤ (↑l).colLen 0 → y (3 + k) l = 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.threeRow_size_three_subsingleton (m m' : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = 3 }) (h : 3 ≤ (↑m).colLen 0) (h' : 3 ≤ (↑m').colLen 0) :
m = m'

theorem QOU.Mathlib.card_three_threeRow_unique (μ : YoungDiagram) (hcard : μ.cells.card = 3) (hrows : 3 ≤ μ.colLen 0) :
μ.cells = {(0, 0), (1, 0), (2, 0)}

theorem QOU.Mathlib.youngPred (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (l : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n + 1 }) (hl : 3 ≤ (↑l).colLen 0) :
∃ (m : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n }), 3 ≤ (↑m).colLen 0 ∧ ∃ (c : ℕ × ℕ) (hc : IsCornerCell (↑l) c), eraseCorner (↑l) c hc = ↑m

theorem QOU.Mathlib.exists_threeRow_corner (μ : YoungDiagram) (hrows : 3 ≤ μ.colLen 0) (hcard : 4 ≤ μ.cells.card) :
∃ (c : ℕ × ℕ) (hc : IsCornerCell μ c), 3 ≤ (eraseCorner μ c hc).colLen 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.card_le_three_of_rowLen_zero_le_one (μ : YoungDiagram) (hrows : μ.colLen 0 = 3) (h0 : μ.rowLen 0 ≤ 1) :
μ.cells.card ≤ 3

theorem QOU.Mathlib.isCorner_lastRow (μ : YoungDiagram) (hne : 0 < μ.colLen 0) :
IsCornerCell μ (μ.colLen 0 - 1, μ.rowLen (μ.colLen 0 - 1) - 1)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.rowLen_eq_zero_of_colLen_le (μ : YoungDiagram) {i : ℕ} (h : μ.colLen 0 ≤ i) :
μ.rowLen i = 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.rowLen_pos_of_lt_colLen (μ : YoungDiagram) {i : ℕ} (h : i < μ.colLen 0) :
0 < μ.rowLen i

theorem QOU.Mathlib.isCorner_rowEnd (μ : YoungDiagram) (i : ℕ) (hpos : 0 < μ.rowLen i) (hdrop : μ.rowLen (i + 1) < μ.rowLen i) :
IsCornerCell μ (i, μ.rowLen i - 1)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.threeRows_iff (μ : YoungDiagram) :
3 ≤ μ.colLen 0 ↔ (2, 0) ∈ μ
